label: copy phase: outputting g/v or about to output v/s/x/t
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase: 92% of activation mass is there, and it is nearly silent on original-phase and delimiter steps. Most of it falls on early-to-mid recall positions (recall_idx 1-4). Inside the copy phase it acts like a graded, token-identity-weighted code over the tokens currently being recalled. It is strongest when the current output is g (rate 42%) or v (36%), and also when the next output is v, s, x or t. Smaller lifts come from 3, l, j and others. The top activations are steps that output g, often in runs of repeated g. The predicate covers about 58% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 34%: many copy steps that output g or v stay below threshold. The lift is spread over many output tokens, so this predicate is a partial description of a distributed code, not a clean single feature.
